# Summary

Analysis of CLB2 + ASH1, SUN4, SRL1, mRNAs by smFISH including bud segmentation, in *Saccharomyces cerevisiae*.
Population-level cell analysis in R started by EW on 8 July 2026, continued through November 2026.

Goal is to produce figures summarizing the dataset:

- abundance and bud localization of mRNAs in wild-type
- comparative bud localization in different strains
- whatever cell statistics we need to support these arguments.

This analysis contributes to figures in the manuscript:

- Figure 2: SRL1 and SUN4 mRNAs have distinct abundance and localization patterns over the cell cycle.
- Figure 3: SRL1 mRNA relies on She2, She3 and partially Ssd1 for its localization to the bud.
- Figure 4. RNA abundance and localization vary smoothly depending on cell size and bud:total size ratio.
- Figure S5: Statistical analysis of mRNA bud-localization of CLB2 + ASH1, SRL1, and SUN4 mRNA.
- Figure S6: Nascent mRNA transcription in the SRL1 and SUN4 mother and bud nuclei is tightly coordinated with cell size.
- Figure S7: SRL1 and SUN4 mRNA localization is not dependent on the complete Sec complex.

There are also many exploratory data analysis figures made, that do not appear in the manuscript.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(GGally)
library(cowplot)
library(tidymodels)
library(ggsignif)
theme_set(theme_cowplot(font_size = 15) + 
            theme(strip.background = element_blank())
)

```


# Load bud segmentation data

Define pixel dimensions in micrometres (um), 0.065 micron per pixel for the 100x objective.

Also set range of sizes to plot for total cell area, bud area, nuclear area, axis limits, in micrometres.

```{r pixel_dimensions}
pixel_width <- 0.065
pixel_area  <- pixel_width^2

cell_area_limits <- c(6, 30)
bud_area_limits  <- c(0, 15)
nuc_area_limits  <- c(0, 3.5)

cell_length_limits <- c(2, 20)
```

```{r strain_names}
# make short table here of strain ids and names in desired order
strain_table <-
  tribble(~strain, ~condition, ~strain_nice,
    "YET915", "WT",    "WT",
    "YET916", "ΔSSD1", "ssd1Δ",
    "YET919", "ΔMPT5", "mpt5∆",
    "YET563", "ΔSHE2", "she2∆",
    "YET572", "ΔSHE3", "she3∆",
    "YET921", "ΔSEC72","sec72∆"
    ) %>%
  mutate(strain_nice = as_factor(strain_nice))

strain_table
```



```{r mrna_names}
mrna_names <- c("CLB2 + ASH1", "SRL1", "SUN4")

mrna_names

mrna_colour_values <- c("CLB2 + ASH1" = "magenta3", 
               "SRL1" = "goldenrod3", 
               "SUN4" = "forestgreen")

scale_colour_mrna <- function(...) {
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = mrna_colour_values,
    ...)
}

scale_fill_mrna <- function(...) {
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = mrna_colour_values,
    ...)
}
```

```{r load_data}
mrna_alldata <- here::here("data", "budSegmentationData20260311.csv") %>%
  read_csv() %>%
  select(!starts_with("Unnamed") ) %>%
  select(!"condition + strain") %>%
  rename(row_id = "...1") %>%
  mutate(replicate = 
           factor(replicate,
                  levels = c("BR1", "BR2", "BR3", "BR4", "BR5")),
         mRNA = factor(mRNA,
                       levels = c("ASH1CLB2", "SRL1", "SUN4"), 
                       labels = c("CLB2 + ASH1", "SRL1", "SUN4"), ),
         area_umsq     = area * pixel_area,
         area_bud_umsq = area_bud * pixel_area,
         axis_minor_length_um = axis_minor_length * pixel_width,
         axis_major_length_um = axis_major_length * pixel_width,
         ) %>%
  rename_with(str_replace_all, pattern = "-", replacement = "_") %>%
  left_join(strain_table, by = c("strain", "condition"))

# The sun4∆ strain (YET918) is in the data file but is excluded from this analysis
mrna_alldata <- mrna_alldata %>%
  filter(strain != "YET918")

mrna_alldata
```
## Count cells per replicate

```{r count_blankcells_by_replicate}
mrna_alldata %>% 
  filter(mRNA == "SRL1") %>%
  group_by(strain_nice, replicate) %>% 
  count() %>%
  print(n = 30)
```

## Count cells with no RNA detected, per strain and mRNA

```{r count_by_replicate}
mrna_alldata %>% 
  filter(total_RNAs == 0) %>%
  count(strain_nice, mRNA) %>%
  print(n = 30)
```

# Overview plots across strains

## mRNAs per cell

```{r plot_mrna_per_cell, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 7}

ggplot(data = mrna_alldata) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = strain_nice, colour = mRNA, y = total_RNAs),
               outlier.size = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA,
             ncol = 1) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  scale_colour_mrna()

```


## mRNAs per mother

```{r plot_mrna_per_mother_allstrains, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 7}

ggplot(data = mrna_alldata, aes(x = strain_nice, colour = mRNA)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = total_RNAs_mother),
               outlier.size = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA,
             ncol = 1) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  scale_colour_mrna()

```

## mRNAs per bud, filtering only for budded cells

```{r plot_mrna_per_bud_allstrains, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 7}
ggplot(data = mrna_alldata %>%
         filter(area_bud > 0), 
       aes(x = strain_nice, colour = mRNA)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = total_RNAs_bud),
               outlier.size = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA,
             ncol = 1) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  scale_colour_mrna()

```


## Count vs total cell area 

### For WT cells, replicates separate

```{r plot_countvsarea_WT, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 4}
plot_count_vs_area_WT <- 
  ggplot(data = mrna_alldata %>%
           filter(area_umsq > 4,
                  strain_nice %in% c("WT")),
         aes(x = area_umsq, y = total_RNAs)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_smooth(aes(linetype = replicate, colour = mRNA),
              method = "gam", se = FALSE) + 
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE) + 
  scale_colour_mrna() + 
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  labs(x = "total cell area (um^2)",
       y = "mRNA count per cell") + 
  guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1),
         linetype = "none")

plot_count_vs_area_WT
```

### For WT cells, replicates together, grid to visualise numbers

```{r plot_countvsarea_vsstrain_WTgrid, fig.height = 8, fig.width = 7}
ggplot(data = mrna_alldata %>%
           filter(
             area_umsq > 4,
             strain_nice %in% c("WT")
           ),
         aes(x = area_umsq, y = total_RNAs)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_smooth(aes(colour = mRNA, fill = mRNA),
              method = "gam",  se = TRUE) + 
  facet_grid(mRNA ~ strain_nice, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey80"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80"),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(colour = "grey85"),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(colour = "grey85"),
        ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = cell_area_limits, ylim = c(0,101),
                  expand = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_mrna() + scale_fill_mrna() +
  labs(x = "total cell area (um^2)",
       y = "mRNA count per cell")

```

## Proportion in bud, across biological replicates, for we relevant strains

## Prop in bud vs bud size for relevant strains

```{r plot_propinbud_vsstrain, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 9}
ggplot(data = mrna_alldata %>%
         filter(strain_nice %in% c("WT", "ssd1Δ", "mpt5∆", "she2∆", "she3∆"),
                area_bud > 0, 
                total_RNAs > 0),
       aes(x = area_bud_umsq, y = total_RNAs_bud / total_RNAs)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_smooth(aes(colour = mRNA, fill = mRNA),
              method = "gam",  se = TRUE) + 
  facet_grid(mRNA ~ strain_nice) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  scale_y_continuous("Proportion of mRNA in bud",
                     limits = c(0,1),
                     breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                     labels = c("0", "", "0.5", "", "1"), 
                     oob = scales::squish) +
  labs(x = "Bud area (um^2)") + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = bud_area_limits, expand = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_mrna()  + scale_fill_mrna()

```


## Prop in bud vs prop of cell *area* in bud for relevant strains


```{r plot_propinbud_vsareainbud_WTgrid, fig.height = 8, fig.width = 7}
ggplot(data = mrna_alldata %>%
         filter(strain_nice %in% c("WT"),
                area_bud > 0, 
                total_RNAs > 0),
       aes(x = area_bud / area, y = total_RNAs_bud / total_RNAs)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey80") + 
  geom_point(size = 0.1, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_smooth(aes(colour = mRNA, fill = mRNA),
              method = "gam",  se = TRUE) + 
  facet_grid(mRNA ~ strain_nice) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey80"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80"),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(colour = "grey85"),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(colour = "grey85"),
        ) +
  scale_y_continuous("Proportion of mRNA in bud",
                     limits = c(0,1),
                     breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                     labels = c("0.00", "0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1.00"), 
                     oob = scales::squish) +
  scale_x_continuous("Bud : total area ratio",
                     limits = c(0,0.53),
                     breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                     labels = c("0", "0.25", "0.5", "", "1")) +
```

## Distribution of mother nuclear area by strain

```{r plot_mothernucareadistn, fig.height = 4, fig.width = 5}
ggplot(data = mrna_alldata ,
       aes(x = mother_nuclei_area * pixel_area)) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 1,
```

# Assign cell cycle phase based on cell statistics

The idea is:

- G1 cells have no bud and nucleus in mother, and few (<= 5) CLB2 + ASH1 mRNAs
- S cells have small buds (under 2 um^2) and only one nucleus, in mother
- G2 cells have larger buds but only one nucleus, in mother
- M cells have 2 nuclei, one in the bud and one in the mother
- some cells might be not assigned so "NA"

Insisting on cells having the right number of nuclei should exclude cells that are not permeabilised, or that are otherwise strange and should not be counted.


We also did not use nuclear shape to assign morphology.

```{r assign_cell_phase}

# pick cells with <= 5 CLB2 + ASH1 mRNAs, for G1
uids_wfewCLB2ASH1 <- 
    mrna_alldata %>%
  filter(mRNA == "CLB2 + ASH1",
         total_RNAs <= 5) %>%
  pull("uid")


mrna_alldata_wphase <-
  mrna_alldata %>%
  # filter for cells of sensible size - 2 um to 20 um
  filter(axis_major_length_um > cell_length_limits[1],
         axis_major_length_um < cell_length_limits[2]) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_cycle_phase = 
      case_when(
        area_bud_umsq == 0 & 
          mother_nuclei_count == 1 &
          uid %in% uids_wfewCLB2ASH1 ~ 
          "G1",
        area_bud_umsq > 0    & 
          area_bud_umsq < 2  & 
          mother_nuclei_count == 1 & 
          nuclei_bud_count == 0 ~ 
          "S",
        area_bud_umsq >= 2 & 
          area_bud_umsq < bud_area_limits[2] & 
          mother_nuclei_count == 1 & 
          nuclei_bud_count == 0 ~ 
          "G2",
        area_bud_umsq >= 2 & 
          mother_nuclei_count == 1 & 
          nuclei_bud_count == 1 ~ 
          "M",
        .default = "NA"
      ) %>%
      factor(levels = c("G1", "S", "G2", "M"))
  )
```

We should check what the unassigned cells are doing - cells that are unreasonably small or have unreasonably large buds - but it is not a large proportion in wild-type.

### Analyse mRNA localization, by cell cycle phase, all strains and replicates


#### Linear regression with t-test difference of mean by strains

```{r fit_mean_propinbud_phase_vs_strain}
fit_mean_propinbud_phase_vs_strain <- 
  mrna_alldata_wphase %>%
  filter( strain_nice  %in% c("WT", "ssd1Δ", "mpt5∆", "she2∆", "she3∆"),
          cell_cycle_phase %in% c("S", "G2", "M")) %>%
  mutate(prop_in_bud = total_RNAs_bud / total_RNAs) %>%
  nest(data = c(-cell_cycle_phase)) %>% 
  mutate(
    fit = map(data, ~ lm(prop_in_bud ~ strain_nice, data = .x)),
    tidied = map(fit, tidy)
  ) %>%
  unnest(tidied) %>%
  select(-data, -fit) %>%
  mutate(strain_nice = term %>%
           str_remove(pattern = "strain_nice") %>%
           factor(levels = c("ssd1Δ", "mpt5∆", "she2∆","she3∆"))
  )

fit_mean_propinbud_phase_vs_strain
```

# Output samples of cells by strain and cell cycle phase

Goal here is to ample at random a small number of cells from each subset that we want to highlight, so that we can spot-check the statistics against cell images and also choose cells to display in a mostly unbiased way.

```{r function_sample_random_cells}
sample_cells_byphase <- function(df, mystrain, myphase, n = 10) {
  df %>%
    filter(mRNA == "CLB2 + ASH1", # because cell stats are repeated 3x
           strain_nice == mystrain, 
           cell_cycle_phase == myphase) %>%
    slice_sample(n=n) %>%
    arrange(row_id)
}

write_sample_cells_byphase <- 
  function(df, mystrain, myphase, filename, n = 10, dirstem = "output") {
    sample_cells_byphase(df = df, mystrain = mystrain, myphase = myphase, n=n) %>%
      select(row_id, uid, strain, condition, replicate, fov, image_cell_id, source_folder) %>%
      write_csv(file = here::here(dirstem, filename))
  }

# test it.
mrna_alldata_wphase %>%
  sample_cells_byphase("WT","G1")
```

Spot-check non-assigned cells, in file `NA_sample20cells.csv`.

```{r nonassigned_cells}

set.seed(2026) # set seed so same pseudorandom sample each time
mrna_alldata_wphase %>%

         # strain_nice == "WT", 
         is.na(cell_cycle_phase)) %>%
  slice_sample(n=20) %>%
  arrange(row_id)%>%
  select(row_id, uid, strain, condition, replicate, fov, image_cell_id, source_folder) %>%
  write_csv(file = here::here("output", "NA_sample20cells.csv"))
```

The next chunk gives ids for 20 cells sampled at random for each combination of

- strain (WT, ssd1∆, mpt5∆, she2∆, she3∆)
- cell cycle phase (G1, S, G2, M)

For example, file  `WT_G1_sample20cells.csv` has 20 cells from WT in G1.


```{r write_sample_random_cells}
set.seed(2026)
expand_grid(strain_nice  = c("WT", "ssd1Δ", "mpt5∆", "she2∆", "she3∆"),
            cell_cycle_phase = c("G1", "S", "G2", "M")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do(write_sample_cells_byphase(df = mrna_alldata_wphase,
                                mystrain = .$strain_nice,
                                myphase = .$cell_cycle_phase,
                                filename = paste(.$strain_nice,
                                                 .$cell_cycle_phase,
                                                 "sample20cells.csv",
                                                 sep = "_"),
                                n = 20)
     )




```
